parts.name: Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the clock hands, likely the minute hand, made of aluminum for lightweight and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock center to indicate minutes or hours depending on its length.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally around the central axis driven by the clock mechanism.

parts.name: Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is another clock hand, likely the hour hand, made of aluminum and shorter than the minute hand.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock center to indicate the hour.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally around the central axis at a slower rate than the minute hand.

parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the clock surface or frame, made of steel with Roman numerals forming the outer structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and displays the time markings for the clock hands to reference.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed background for the rotating hands.
